QIMING / DOMAINS

Use cases

Development, writing, site operations, and computer care grow from the work you actually do.

Writing

Turn scattered material into chapter one

Say this

This folder has old drafts, interview notes, and ideas. Inventory the material and sources, agree on the question for this chapter with me, draft chapter one, and leave revision notes and the next chapter task.

Qiming keeps track of

A draft, source trail, open questions, and a next-chapter entry.

Site operations

Plan a week of content updates

Say this

Review the site categories, recent posts, and publishing flow. Plan three posts with goals, owners, and dates. After the first, record the preview, live result, and follow-up checks.

Qiming keeps track of

Site status, content schedule, publication evidence, and review task.

Learning

Organize a course from zero

Say this

Inventory these notes and exercises, identify what I know, and propose a seven-day plan. Do only lesson one today; record missed questions and tomorrow’s review.

Qiming keeps track of

Learning goal, daily steps, mistakes, and review trail.

Open source

Revive a repository left idle

Say this

Read the README, open Issues, tests, and recent changes. Pick one bounded problem, fix it, run the relevant checks, and list older problems still unverified.

Qiming keeps track of

Current state, one verified change, and remaining issues.

Small team

Turn a client request into a deliverable

Say this

Read the request, meeting notes, and delivered files. Separate agreed items from open questions, then list the owner, acceptance condition, and missing client input for the next delivery.

Qiming keeps track of

Source of requests, ownership, acceptance, and blockers.

Research

Turn research files into an answer

Say this

Organize the papers, links, and experiment notes by question. Cite the source and uncertainty for each conclusion, then propose the next test.

Qiming keeps track of

Traceable conclusions, evidence, and untested hypotheses.
